name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source web and product analytics with events, funnels, retention and dashboards, backed by PostgreSQL, Redis and ClickHouse.

alerts.message: The first account you register becomes the owner, and public sign-up closes after it. Password resets and invitation emails are only sent once SMTP_HOST, SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS (or RESEND_API_KEY) are filled in the environment; until then they are written to the API logs.
